hero.headline: Building dependable software architectures and expressive interactive worlds.
hero.lead: I am Sakti, an independent developer who bridges structured full-stack engineering with experimental game mechanics. Whether designing relational backends, mobile operational workflows, or narrative RPG systems, I focus on clarity, tactile responsiveness, and purposeful craft.

home.selectedWorksSubtitle: Every project is treated as an architectural problem, balancing data modeling, interface ergonomics, and runtime feel.
home.focusIntro: Software engineering and game development often sit in separate worlds. In my practice, they sharpen one another: enterprise software brings architectural discipline to game state, while game design brings frame-level responsiveness to web and mobile interfaces.

aboutPage.title: Engineering utility, crafting atmosphere.
aboutPage.lead: I am Sakti, a developer focused on Full-Stack Development and Game Development. I build digital products that combine clean underlying systems with thoughtful human interaction.
aboutPage.storyP1: My fascination with computing started from two complementary questions: how complex applications manage data reliably behind the scenes, and how interactive worlds evoke curiosity and emotion on screen.
aboutPage.storyP2: Rather than narrowing myself into a single rigid box early on, I pursued both full-stack application engineering and game development. Working across React, TypeScript, Laravel, and MySQL taught me how to structure APIs, relational schemas, and maintainable frontends. Building with Flutter and Odoo exposed me to real-world operational workflows on mobile devices. Exploring Godot allowed me to design state machines, narrative progression, and spatial interactions from the ground up.
aboutPage.storyP3: Today, I approach every project (whether a review platform, an operational mobile app, or a game) with the same core standard: understand the problem deeply, design a clear architecture, and sweat the interactive details.

principles.title: Structure Before Decoration
principles.body: A reliable data model and clear state flow matter more than surface-level visual tricks. Good UI grows naturally from well-organized domain logic.

principles.title: Cross-Pollination of Disciplines
principles.body: Game development teaches frame-level responsiveness and state clarity; full-stack engineering teaches modularity, schema integrity, and maintainability.

principles.title: Honest, Maintainable Craft
principles.body: Write code that future collaborators and my future self can read, debug, and extend without friction.

principles.title: Continuous Curiosity
principles.body: Technology evolves constantly. Staying hands-on with new runtimes, engines, and architectural patterns keeps problem-solving sharp.
